file_impact.reason: the defect: the _git helper (:40-46) hardcodes git -C <repo>, which git refuses for a bare repo under safe.bareRepository=explicit. The five bare-remote call sites (:401, :402, :415, :423, :435) need the top-level --git-dir form -- but _git is ALSO used on non-bare worktrees (tracker, writer, tmp_path init/clone), so a blanket -C -> --git-dir swap is wrong; add a sibling bare-repo helper instead

the coverage gap that allowed the recurrence: the held-out oracle from ticket 3476 pins a hardcoded 3-entry _FIXTURE_NODES allowlist, so a NEW file reintroducing git -C <bare> is never checked. Derive the covered set from the tree instead of hand-maintaining it, or make an unregistered bare-fixture test fail
